name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ConferenceSettingActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this pre-meeting screen when the user creates or joins a meeting. It lets the user check the camera, microphone, and speaker before starting or joining the call.
disableEffect: Users cannot complete the create-or-join setup, so they may be unable to start or join a meeting.
